parameters.scope: Sharp-clipped finite void tools as a baseline before transition blending; no carrier geometry or manufacturing qualification
parameters.reason_for_geometric_margin: Avoid coincident clipping faces while retaining exact empty outside-core and unchanged numerical gates; the earlier sharp coincident clip is refused
parameters.normalization: one fixed as_original().simplify(0) before export; retain exact final oriented-triangle roundtrip
parameters.cap_distance_crosscheck: Independently construct convex-combination witnesses on candidate triangle edges/interior; if that candidate fails, search every clip triangle. A witness within the unchanged cap threshold proves proximity, even when libigl selected the wrong skinny triangle.
parameters.sphere_controls_method: Native level_set of signed sphere distance using tolerance=1e-5, identical root-refinement setting to the finite gyroid; recomputed on every call.
